newsitem.title: GERMANY: BHF raises Bayer 1996 EPS forecast.
newsitem.headline: BHF raises Bayer 1996 EPS forecast.

text.p: BHF Bank said on Tuesday that it has raised its earnings per share estimate for German chemicals group Bayer AG to 4.05 marks in 1996 from 3.90 marks.
A BHF analyst explained that Bayer's lower tax rate prompted the bank to make the change but that the estimate for 1997 was left unchanged.
"The net profit number for the nine months was very positive showing the group now enjoys a lower tax rate," the analyst said.
Bayer nine month group pre-tax profit was 3.7 billion marks while the net profit was 2.3 billion marks.
